candidates.change_summary: Change burn to allow anyone (remove onlyOwner) so totalSupply can be decreased by non-owners calling burn, altering observable totalSupply after burn calls.
Modify burn so it subtracts twice the requested value from totalSupply, causing totalSupply to differ after burn.
Modify burn to forget to decrease totalSupply (remove the totalSupply decrement), so totalSupply remains unchanged after burn.

Change owned() to revert always (require false), which prevents owner-only functions guarded by onlyOwner from being callable if onlyOwner depended on owned (note: onlyOwner modifier uses msg.sender==owner directly, so this edit does not affect onlyOwner; however modifying this unit to require false is a distinct single-statement edit).
Replace the owner-only restriction so burn is callable by anyone (remove onlyOwner modifier).
Require a different account's balance (owner's) instead of msg.sender, so burn reduces caller only if owner has enough and decreases caller incorrectly (logic change).
Emit Burn event with owner as from address instead of msg.sender.
Decrease totalSupply before updating caller's balance (reorder two statements).
Make burn subtract from a fixed key (owner) instead of msg.sender, so burning affects owner balance rather than caller.
